page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the x86_64 architecture and includes 35 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512, AES, and FMA.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the instance delivers average multi-core capabilities, as demonstrated by its middle-tier scores in multi-core stress-ng tests, PassMark CPU evaluations, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. However, single-core performance is a notable tradeoff, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded compression tests ranking in the lower percentiles. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the average tier for both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block read/write operations.

The ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying entirely on external network-attached storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. Given its balanced resource distribution and average performance in database operations, Redis SET transactions, and static web serving, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, moderate database hosting, web serving, and lightweight multi-threaded application servers.

It is best suited for general-purpose applications, static web serving, Redis deployments, and moderate database operations.
